newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Banks shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday as Audi shares rose to $16.5 from $16.375 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares fell to $12 from $12.125.
Solidere A shares fell to $10.5 from Thursday's $10.75 while B shares rose to $11.25 from $10.875.
Turnover in BLC was 2,000 shares, up from 500, and in Audi 25,700 shares against Thursday's 31,043 shares which included a block trade of 13,100 shares traded outside the floor.
Also traded on the BSE were 10,500 shares of piping maker Eternit at $1.625 compared with 1,500 shares that changed hands at $1.5625 on Thursday.
There was no trade in the three other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 98,673 shares for a value of $1,124,205 against 83,969 shares for a value of $995,810.
The BLOM stock index rose 0.62 percent to 919.37 and the LISPI stock index rose 0.47 percent to 81.16.
